identity.name: Arian Gogani
identity.bio: I build reproducible systems that test what AI verification actually checked, then turn the result into evidence a stranger can inspect.
identity.short_bio: Granite Bay High School student building reproducible systems for AI decision integrity. Creator of Nobulex.

projects.name: Nobulex
projects.description: Executable research on verification boundaries: skipped coverage, self-selected trust anchors, policy scope, log integrity, and ambiguous evidence.
projects.proof: 27 synthetic fixtures, six paired historical parser cases, and public CI.

projects.name: Decision-integrity gateway
projects.description: A Python prototype that separates evidence status from execution policy before a financial action can proceed.
projects.proof: PASS, FAIL, or INDETERMINATE evidence feeds a separate PERMIT, BLOCK, or ESCALATE decision.

projects.name: Fail-open corpus
projects.description: Minimal reproductions of evaluators and safety checks that can report success without completing the check their result appears to certify.
projects.proof: Each published case names its reproduction limits instead of generalizing from one defect.

projects.name: Surka
projects.description: A small app for keeping two-sided cross-promotion swaps on track, from agreed terms through delivery evidence and results.
projects.proof: The public app is live at [surka.vercel.app](https://surka.vercel.app). No completed real-world swaps or paying users are claimed.

architecture.name: Collect evidence
architecture.description: Bind the proposed action to the exact inputs, sources, timestamps, and identities it depends on.

architecture.name: Establish status
architecture.description: Return PASS, FAIL, or INDETERMINATE. Missing evidence never becomes a clean result.

architecture.name: Apply policy
architecture.description: A bounded deterministic policy returns PERMIT, BLOCK, or ESCALATE.

architecture.name: Preserve the decision
architecture.description: Sign a receipt that binds the action, evidence references, policy version, and outcome.

external_results.label: Four conformance-harness pull requests merged
external_results.detail: The public research distinguishes merged changes from endorsement and freshly reruns only the case it says it reruns.

external_results.label: Two Kill Bill catalog-billing fixes proposed upstream
external_results.detail: Open [PR #2320](https://github.com/killbill/killbill/pull/2320) and [PR #2321](https://github.com/killbill/killbill/pull/2321) have released-tag H2 invoice checks that were red before and green after. Current-master CI is unverified; these are proposals, not merged fixes or customer results.

external_results.label: OWASP receipt-guidance update approved by a reviewer
external_results.detail: The narrowed PR is still open and under review. Approval is not a merge or endorsement.

external_results.label: A verifier defect reproduced and fixed upstream
external_results.detail: The maintainer reproduced the failure, released a corrected verifier, and confirmed all four negative checks.

external_results.label: Verification-boundary research runs in public CI
external_results.detail: The fixture expectations, historical replay metadata, and deliberate-regression checks are inspectable.

achievements.title: Execution-receipt guidance merged into OWASP AST09
achievements.summary: OWASP changed the AST09 risk page itself to include execution-receipt implementation guidance.
achievements.caveat: A merged contribution is not an OWASP endorsement of Nobulex.

achievements.title: Descriptor traversal fix merged into the AGV validator
achievements.summary: The validator now detects descriptor_dimensions shape instead of assuming it. CodeQL, validation, drift, and DCO checks passed before merge.
achievements.caveat: This corrects the older note that the pull request was still waiting on DCO.

achievements.title: Five contributions merged into shared agent-governance test vectors
achievements.summary: One Nobulex implementation and four later verifier, parser, emitter, and negative-vector changes were merged into ScopeBlind's shared conformance repository.
achievements.caveat: The public research freshly reruns #22 only. Merge does not certify the broader Nobulex product.

achievements.title: AML and sanctions cheat sheet merged into OWASP
achievements.summary: A 276-line cheat sheet for AML and sanctions controls in AI-agent payments was added to the OWASP Cheat Sheet Series.
achievements.caveat: The merged document is guidance, not a certification or legal-compliance guarantee.

achievements.title: Verifiable-compliance-receipts proposal merged into Microsoft's toolkit
achievements.summary: Microsoft's Agent Governance Toolkit added the 75-line proposal to its live documentation tree.
achievements.caveat: This is a proposal in the toolkit, not a Microsoft product endorsement.

achievements.title: Nobulex referenced in Microsoft AI Agents for Beginners
achievements.summary: Lesson 18 added the Nobulex Python receipt SDK to its production references.
achievements.caveat: A one-line reference is not adoption or endorsement.

achievements.title: IETF AUDIT charter corrections merged during review
achievements.summary: Deliverable numbering and eight editorial errors were corrected in the AUDIT BoF preparation charter.
achievements.caveat: This was an editorial contribution, not authorship of the charter or IETF endorsement.

achievements.title: AST-mapped adversarial fixture-corpus proposal merged
achievements.summary: OWASP added the fixture-corpus proposal and two AST09 vectors to its proposals directory.
achievements.caveat: It is a discussion proposal, not normative OWASP specification text.

achievements.title: OWASP receipt-guidance update approved for further review
achievements.summary: A reviewer approved the narrowed cheat-sheet change clarifying receipt canonicalization and binding a screening result to its transaction. Another reviewer requested further review.
achievements.caveat: One approval is not a merge, OWASP endorsement, or adoption. Review and CI status can change; check the linked pull request for the current state.

achievements.title: CVE-2026-45316 recovered from source without advisory knowledge
achievements.summary: Enforcement Coverage reconstructed a weaker read-vs-write permission check from sibling routes and matched the already-published Open WebUI vulnerability.
achievements.caveat: Recovered, not first discovered. The official advisory classifies it as CWE-863 and low severity.

achievements.title: Witness Independence scale, vectors, and reference grader
achievements.summary: The W0-W4 model grades where a receipt's trust anchor came from. A fresh documented-dependency run completed 36 checks with zero failures.
achievements.caveat: This is Arian's own model and implementation. Its self-test is not independent validation.

achievements.title: Nobulex solution entry merged alongside other OWASP tools
achievements.summary: OWASP's solutions catalog added a 41-line Nobulex entry.
achievements.caveat: A catalog listing is not normative guidance or endorsement.

achievements.title: Nobulex package merged into the Dify plugin marketplace
achievements.summary: The packaged Nobulex plugin was added to Dify's official plugin repository.
achievements.caveat: Marketplace inclusion is distribution, not proof of adoption or correctness.

achievements.title: Nobulex added to Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit adopters
achievements.summary: The toolkit's ADOPTERS file added Nobulex as its first listed adopter.
achievements.caveat: The entry was submitted by Arian and does not establish Microsoft endorsement.

achievements.title: Medicare policy archival baseline measured across 85 documents
achievements.summary: The audit reports 41 of 85 surveyed policies, 48%, with zero archived versions in the measured Wayback CDX results.
achievements.caveat: The repository labels this a baseline spike and publishes negative results and scope limits.

achievements.title: DefaultDrift measured 1,253 patch releases
achievements.summary: The current repository reports 62 passing tests and a 12-mutation battery with every mutation caught.
achievements.caveat: This corrects the older 61-case, 11-mutation count. The current code is public.

achievements.title: Nobulex listed in awesome-mcp-servers
achievements.summary: The MCP Compliance Server was added to the directory's security section.
achievements.caveat: A directory row is discoverability, not adoption.

achievements.title: THESIS.md publishes five observable falsifiers
achievements.summary: The project states five conditions that would make the original registry thesis wrong and preserves a correction explaining why they do not fully test the current gateway product.
achievements.caveat: This is self-critique, not external validation.

achievements.title: yfinance price-adjustment observability patch submitted
achievements.summary: The patch proposed stamping every return path so callers could determine whether requested price adjustment actually happened. It included a ten-case test design and live ticker follow-up.
achievements.caveat: The collaborator closed it without merge. It must not be described as an accepted upstream fix.
